title: Privacy

controllerData: [Name and address in the legal notice]
dataIntro: We collect and process the following personal data:
accountData: Account data (name, email address and password hash)

rightsDescription: You have the right to access, rectify or erase your data, restrict processing and request data portability (Articles 15–20 GDPR). To exercise these rights, contact
complaintsDescription: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority. The competent authority is the one for the German state where you reside.
retentionDescription: We automatically delete analytics data after 30, 365 or 730 days, depending on your plan. We delete account data immediately on request.
templateReminder: This privacy policy is a template. Have a legal professional adapt it to your circumstances.
